transit.label: Transit commuters
transit.what: Share of workers aged 16 and over who get to work by public transportation.

novehicle.label: Homes without a vehicle
novehicle.what: Share of occupied homes with no car, truck or van available.

renters.label: Renters
renters.what: Share of occupied homes that are rented.

rentstress.label: Rent takes 30% or more of income
rentstress.what: Share of renting homes spending 30% or more of their income on rent, out of those where the share could be worked out.

income.label: Median household income
income.what: The middle household income, in 2024 dollars. Half of households earn more, half earn less.

electric.label: Homes heated by electricity
electric.what: Share of occupied homes that use electricity as their main heating fuel. A rough sign of how many households depend on the power bill for heat.

population.label: Population
population.what: Total people living in the district.
